newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key June JGB futures fall one point to 123.05.
newsitem.headline: Key June JGB futures fall one point to 123.05.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures dropped by one full point to 123.05 in early Tokyo trade on Friday.

JGB futures were under strong selling pressure, in line with cash prices, from the beginning of Friday's Tokyo trade, as speculation heightened about possible credit tightening by the Bank of Japan, traders said.
Follow-through sales, led mainly by dealers, hammered the futures further to as low as 122.80, after they opened at 123.15. JGB futures closed in Tokyo at 124.05 on Thursday.
